title: Forrester names Kong a Leader in API management software
summary: The Q3 2026 Forrester Wave recognition provides independent competitive validation for Kong's API-management position and AI-governance strategy. It supports the existing product thesis, but does not justify another score increase because it overlaps prior Gartner recognition and discloses no commercial or financial contribution.
confirmed: Forrester named Kong a Leader in The Forrester Wave: API Management Software, Q3 2026, an evaluation based on current offering, strategy, and customer feedback.

Kong's release quotes the report as highlighting its AI-control-plane vision and AI-governance breadth, while also citing GSI demand for implementations and positive customer feedback on support and gateway performance.
uncertain: The announcement does not disclose Kong's full scoring relative to every competitor or whether the recognition has changed win rates, pricing, bookings, ARR, retention, or revenue growth.
No IPO filing, financing, verified secondary transaction, margin disclosure, cash-flow metric, customer concentration, or fully diluted share count accompanied the recognition.
